Therefore 1,289/1,289 SUCCESS is a claim about persisted attempt records, not proof that every physical provider attempt was pre-journaled; the closed-loop estimand is a policy pipeline under independent calls, not a same-proposal intervention. No independent protocol-matched replication or failed replication was found.
